speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; to narrow down the cause, could you describe the quality of your weakness (e.g., generalized, proximal, or one-sided) and whether you have experienced any shortness of breath or palpitations? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the Complete Blood Count returned normal readings, the symptoms are likely not caused by anemia or infection. Can you tell me if your weakness is worse when you get up from a chair or lift your arms, and do you have any swelling in your legs or recent weight gain? REQUEST TEST: Electrolytes.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal electrolyte panel rules out significant imbalances, so could you tell me if you experience muscle pain or stiffness, and whether you have noticed any changes in your muscle strength during physical activity? REQUEST TEST: Creatine_Kinase.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal Creatine Kinase results make significant muscle inflammation or rhabdomyolysis unlikely. I need to determine if your weakness is associated with any muscle cramps or tingling in your hands and feet. REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Stimulating_Hormone.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you; the normal Thyroid Stimulating Hormone results rule out thyroid dysfunction as the cause of your fatigue. Given that CBC, electrolytes, Creatine Kinase, and TSH are all normal, I need to know if you have unintentional weight loss, excessive thirst or urination, or a family history of autoimmune conditions. REQUEST TEST: Glucose_Fasting; REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_Panel.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal Glucose and Autoimmune Panel results have ruled out diabetes and common autoimmune causes. To further evaluate your generalized weakness and fatigue, please tell me if you have noticed any darkening of your skin, especially in skin folds, and if you have a history of high blood pressure. REQUEST TEST: Plasma_Renin_Activity; REQUEST TEST: Aldosterone.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I have now reviewed the normal results for your TSH, glucose, autoimmune panel, and the plasma renin and aldosterone levels, which rules out thyroid disease, diabetes, common autoimmune disorders, and primary adrenal insufficiency. With all our targeted labs coming back normal, could you tell me if your fatigue has been present for more than six months and if it is relieved by rest?

REQUEST TEST: Vitamin_D_Level; REQUEST TEST: Ferritin.

speaker: Doctor
text: With Vitamin D and Ferritin levels also normal, we have effectively ruled out common nutritional deficiencies and metabolic causes for your fatigue. Have you experienced any recent fevers, night sweats, or swollen lymph nodes, and does your fatigue persist throughout the day despite adequate rest? REQUEST TEST: Erythrocyte_Sedimentation_Rate; REQUEST TEST: C-Reactive_Protein. REQUEST TEST: Iron_Feritin.
